==About==

An {{i|Eloped Gingerbread Man}} is received by chance when preparing Food on a {{i|Baking Table}}. With the [[Bullying]] Skill learned you can right-click an Eloped Gingerbread Man and select "Interrogate" to split it into {{i|Gingerbread Man Arms}}, {{i|Gingerbread Man Head}}, and {{i|Gingerbread Man Torso}}.
